fixes.name: Native Anaglyph 3D
fixes.pros: Built-in Dual-View Rendering — not a depth fake. FEZ-specific shader preserves non-anaglyph UI colour during SBS/TAB conversion.
fixes.cons: Requires New Game+ or save file workaround to unlock. Must re-enable 3D each launch.
fixes.notes: FEZ uses Dual-View Rendering internally and outputs red/cyan anaglyph. Other anaglyph variants (green/magenta, amber/blue) are produced by first converting to SBS via the FEZ shader, then repacking with 3DtoElse.
fixes.activation: Requires New Game+ to unlock the 3D Glasses item. Shortcut: rename a 209.4% save file to SaveSlot2 in %APPDATA%\FEZ\. Close Steam before launching FEZ.exe. Collect the 3D Glasses outside the starting room. Each launch: Game Settings → Stereoscopy → Anaglyph Cyan/Red.
issues: Must re-enable stereoscopy in Game Settings every launch
Some UI elements are outside the anaglyph pass — use the FEZ-specific shader, not the generic one
Close Steam before launching or the game may not load correctly
